target.title: fix(feishu): WebSocket encryptKey SecretRefs are ignored at runtime
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu WebSocket users who explicitly configure `channels.feishu.encryptKey` as a SecretRef would have that configured key ignored during runtime secret resolution, even though the same field worked when configured as a plain string.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Feishu account resolver now resolves `encryptKey` through the same SecretRef-aware path regardless of event transport. The runtime secret contract also treats explicitly configured top-level and account-level WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs as active for enabled accounts, without making `encryptKey` required for WebSocket mode or changing the existing webhook requirements.

## User Impact

Feishu WebSocket configurations can keep an optional `encryptKey` in an environment-backed or runtime-resolved SecretRef and have the resolved value reach the Feishu SDK event dispatcher. Configurations that omit `encryptKey` continue to work as before, and disabled Feishu accounts still do not resolve inactive account secrets.

## Evidence

- Focused regression tests pass for Feishu account resolution and secret-contract runtime assignment:

  ```text
  [test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts
  The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.
  
   RUN  v4.1.9 [local path redacted]
  
  
   Test Files  2 passed (2)
        Tests  25 passed (25)
     Start at  01:01:42
     Duration  11.48s (transform 6.80s, setup 290ms, import 10.71s, tests 50ms, environment 0ms)
  
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 26.76s
  ```

- Near-real runtime proof resolves the WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRef through OpenClaw secret assignment, Feishu account resolution, and into the SDK `EventDispatcher`:

  ```text
  [info]: [ 'event-dispatch is ready' ]
  {"assignments":1,"accountEncryptKey":"runtime-proof-key","dispatcherEncryptKey":"runtime-proof-key"}
  ```

- Extension production typecheck passes:

  ```text
  $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo
  ```

- Extension test typecheck passes:

  ```text
  $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
  ```
